input.summary: Garden overgrowth (tree and weeds) at Flat 17, 67 Willowmere Road, reported by tenant Freya Palmer on 16 Dec. Landlord approval was recorded on 17 Dec (approval #15, no amount set). Riverside Services was assigned and instructed on 17 Dec (event 008). Reminders were sent on 18, 20 and 23 Dec (events 009-011), and none of them got a reply. A system flag was raised on 25 Dec (event 012). On 17 Dec Langley told the tenant 'the gardener is on annual leave' and would be booked on his return (event 004). The tenant has had no update since 17 Dec.
input.checked: I read all 12 events. There is no inbound message from the contractor or the tenant anywhere on the ticket. There are no open holds, no attachments and no property history. The landlord and contractor profiles have no contact details or facts on record.
input.uncertain: 1) Whether Riverside's silence is down to the annual leave mentioned in event 004, and when the gardener is back. 2) The contractor was given two different tenant numbers: 07700 900504 ext 900418 in event 008, and 07700 900710 in the reminders. Riverside may not have been able to reach the tenant. 3) The tenant said the overgrowth is in a COMMUNAL area (event 002). Communal gardens are usually the freeholder's or block managing agent's job, not the individual landlord's. Nobody seems to have checked this before approval and assignment. 4) We don't know the tree's size, whether it is near cables or the building, or whether access or pets need considering. 5) Approval #15 has no cost cap.
input.recommendation: Ops team: 1) Phone Riverside Services to find out whether they have the job, when the gardener is back from leave, and which tenant number is correct. If there's no booking soon, reassign to another gardener. 2) Before any work or quote goes ahead, check whether the garden is communal under the lease or block management. If it is, send it to the freeholder or managing agent and tell the landlord. 3) Any quote Riverside sends needs landlord sign-off on the amount, because the approval on file has no cap. I've emailed the tenant an update and set a 3-day follow-up.

I've escalated it to the ops team (normal priority) to chase or reassign the contractor.
